## Purpose

Describe the single feature or fix and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] The source change and its tests are included together.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes from a clean install.
- [ ] No credentials, generated output, or personal data are committed.
- [ ] User-facing and operational documentation is updated where needed.

## Evidence

Include test output, screenshots, or API examples that make the change easy to review.
